# GitHub Actions

CI/CD workflows and reusable actions.

Planned workflows:
- `workflows/ci.yml` — Lint, unit tests, integration, security scan on PRs
- `workflows/cd.yml` — Publish Docker images, deploy to staging
- `workflows/release.yml` — Semantic version releases & changelog

See [`docs/project_structure.md`](../docs/project_structure.md) §12.
